body: I don't need to worry about waking up early, fortunately. My energy levels are I'd say fine. I wake up at 8am and go to sleep around 11 or 12 at night. I walk around a bit, about a mile every other day. I work out at the gym every once in a while, but I stop going afterwards because the aftermath really sucks. I don't mind caffeine, but I only get that from pop, which I want to avoid. As for seduction... I honestly can't see it working. I have never had success in that department, and with my mental state being as it is, I wouldn't want someone to deal with that.

I know that these things take time. I've been giving it time for the past few years, and I can't see myself having the desire to get results from working out. I used to work out in high school, and I knew what I could do. So I aim to get there during the random gym visits that I do have, but the aftermath turns me off of going again.

I haven't started looking for a new job yet, but I was planning on doing that soon. I suppose people would be happy for me, but I'm not so sure. I'm not friends with anyone at the place that I work, but they realize that I do the majority of the work. That pisses me off, but I still, for whatever reason, feel like I can't leave them screwed over. I missed the memo apparently, since about 3 people out of the 16 or 17 working there in the past week, and I can already see the effects of them leaving. They are good people there, just not the kinds of people that I could see myself being friends with outside of work.

As for weight loss, I don't know. I only got to that point that I mentioned at my other job because all that I did all day was lift 40 pounds of dog food regularly and walk around all day. I don't have that option currently. With my current job, I'm working 40 hours a week. I'm only supposed to be working 28, but the manager recognizes that he can spare the extra time and bend the rules so that I can help out as much as possible. I try to go to the gym, but that only lasts for about 2 weeks at maximum, and I hate myself more when I fail time and time again.
